race.comment: ANGRYPANTS ANGIE (6) finished seventh first-up last time out when she broke in a 1800m event at this track three weeks ago. Meets a similar line up so she is sure to be a force if the manners improve. UP THE BOMBER (3) faces the starter for the first time. By Mel Mara and hails from the T J Ryan stable. No excuses from this advantageous draw. Looks to have some ability based on a recent trial win. Any push in betting will add to the confidence. JUST MILZY (5) was out of the money two runs ago then broke and finished eighth last start over 1800m at Kapunda, coming home 40 metres from the winner. Finds a nice race and can make up for that last start mishap. ALWAYS A STUNNER (4) is a two-year-old gelding by Always B Miki from Smiling Stunner on debut. Placed in a recent trial. Finds a nice race so anticipating a bright start to his career.
